posts.content:
Sync the entire Community screen and all of its features with the currently authenticated user and the real backend/database.

- Remove any mock, hardcoded, placeholder, or localStorage-based community data.
- Ensure all community data is fetched from and persisted to the backend for the authenticated user.
- Every user must only see and interact with data they are authorized to access.
- Ensure actions such as posts, comments, likes, replies, profiles, and other community interactions are properly tied to the correct authenticated user.
- Make the data persist across app restarts, devices, and sessions.
- Ensure proper authentication checks and database-level security/RLS where applicable.
- Do not change the existing UI, layout, design, navigation, or functionality. Only fix the underlying data flow and synchronization.
- Carefully inspect the entire Community screen and its related components/services to identify and replace all mock/local data sources, including hidden ones.

The final result should be a fully functional, production-ready Community screen where every user sees and interacts with their real, authenticated, backend-synced data.
